title: Browncloaks
content:
The Browncloaks include at least [[Elwen]] the [[snickersnees|Snickersnee]] and her companions, a one-legged [[gnomes|gnomish illusionist]], a [[crowfolk]] ratter and a masked [[deep dwarves|deep dwarven]] machinist. They are drinking in Farnsfall ([[11.03]]) and claim to have looted a hidden [[dragons|dragon]] cave - leaving behind mountains of copper pennies ([[08.01]]).
==Former members==
* [[Albus Flidge]], now a creator of clockwork
